# optimizelycmp_settings (Data Source)

A read-only export of the organisation's configuration (the API's GET /settings; experimental). Each section is returned as JSON text so it keeps the API's shape. Nothing is changed in CMP.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "optimizelycmp_settings" "current" {}

# Each section is JSON text in the API's own shape.
locals {
  workflow_names = [for w in jsondecode(data.optimizelycmp_settings.current.workflows_json) : w.name]
  label_groups   = [for l in jsondecode(data.optimizelycmp_settings.current.labels_json) : l.label_type]
}

# webhooks_json is sensitive because it contains each webhook's secret.
output "webhook_names" {
  value = [for w in jsondecode(nonsensitive(data.optimizelycmp_settings.current.webhooks_json)) : w.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `apps_json` (String) Apps. As a JSON string in the API's own shape; read it with jsondecode().
- `custom_fields_json` (String) Custom fields: an object keyed by field type (currency, dropdown, ...), each holding a list. As a JSON string in the API's own shape; read it with jsondecode().
- `id` (String) Always "settings"; present because every data source needs an ID.
- `labels_json` (String) Label groups and their labels. As a JSON string in the API's own shape; read it with jsondecode().
- `routing_rules_json` (String) Routing rules. As a JSON string in the API's own shape; read it with jsondecode().
- `templates_json` (String) Templates, with their form fields, sections and instructions. As a JSON string in the API's own shape; read it with jsondecode().
- `webhooks_json` (String, Sensitive) Webhooks. **Sensitive**: the export includes each webhook's secret. As a JSON string in the API's own shape; read it with jsondecode().
- `workflows_json` (String) Workflows, with their steps, labels, custom fields and channels. As a JSON string in the API's own shape; read it with jsondecode().
